plan.title: BOQ draft hides ordinary line-item controls

steps.note: Open the BOQ project creation screen, the closest available path to a new BOQ draft.
Provide the required project title so the draft can be saved.
Apply a BOQ template so the BOQ create form is in its configured state.
Create the new BOQ project draft requested by the setup.
Assert that the ordinary project Items control is absent from the BOQ screen.
Assert that the ordinary line-item count is not shown on the BOQ draft.
Check the BOQ screen for absence of the ordinary Line Items section; this does not cover the unavailable RFP-stage form.
